$comment: Adds the patterns of this child theme to the contract of Leitvia (extends); roles, pairs, rules and the patterns of Leitvia come from the parent theme. Every file in patterns/ needs an entry here with the title and description of its header. A preset in theme.json needs a role in the contract of Leitvia first, see readme.txt.

patterns.title: Starter section
patterns.description: Example pattern of the child theme with an eyebrow, a heading and a short text in the reading width. Copy it to start a pattern of your own.
patterns.useWhen: As a template for the first pattern of the child theme; replace its text before it reaches a page.

docs.avoidWhen: The page needs a real section; this one only shows the shape of a child theme pattern.
docs.a11y: One h2 below the heading of the page, text in ink-muted on surface.
